answer_1.quote: We evaluate the open‑ended text generation quality via human and automatic evaluations... We sample 200 prompts from the full 5000 prompts and their corresponding generations from GPT (XXL) and RETRO (XXL)... assign them to annotators for fluency and coherence evaluation.

answer_2.quote: We follow prior work and consider the following metrics: Repetition %, SELF‑BLEU, Zipf Coefficient... We also evaluate factuality on FACTUALITYPROMPTS and TruthfulQA, and toxicity on REALTOXICITYPROMPTS.

answer_4.quote: Participants were recruited through Amazon MTurk... We adapt the instructions from prior work and show the annotation instructions for coherence and fluency evaluation on Amazon MTurk platform.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to rate each generated continuation on fluency (1‑5) and coherence (1‑5).
